name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in São Paulo, he was always fascinated by how things worked, often disassembling and reassembling toys and appliances. This curiosity led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in materials science and quality assurance. While initially considering a career in the automotive industry, a chance encounter with a local racing team during a university project ignited his passion for motorsport.

He started as a volunteer, meticulously inspecting components and learning the intricacies of race car construction. Ricardo's dedication and keen eye for detail quickly earned him a reputation for identifying potential issues before they became critical failures. He believes that rigorous quality control is paramount to success in racing, emphasizing precision and consistency in every aspect of the car's build. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and mechanics.

Ricardo is eager to contribute his skills to a competitive team, where he can continue to develop his expertise and make a tangible impact on performance. He believes his commitment to excellence and his collaborative spirit make him a valuable asset.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a stocky build and a friendly, approachable face.
